evaluation_context: Evaluated on holdout split of 160 procedurally drawn PIL image textures.
synthetic_benchmark_warning: 100% metrics are an artifact of easily separable synthetic shapes (lines vs dots). They DO NOT represent real-world agricultural visual performance.
scientific_boundary: Detects visible surface anomalies and mould-like discoloration patterns. DOES NOT quantify chemical mycotoxins, aflatoxin ppb, or nutritional fractions.
